environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-rest. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with RLS policy on `documents` table using `current_setting('app.current_tenant')`. The `audit_log` table has NO RLS policy. Database connection user is `app_user` which has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables. No WAF or input validation layer in front of API Gateway. JWT issued by Cognito with custom claims including `tenant_id` and `role`.

config.db_user_permissions: GRANT ALL ON documents, audit_log TO app_user
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway REST, no request validation
